decision: Repair the acceptance oracle using authoritative execution retirement. No claim that a product worker lifecycle bug was fixed, and no claim of native green.
findings: Native37200570100 establishes exact pre-click old version0/target correlation; subsequent old stopped/redundant with targetId omitted; old host remains present attached=false. Neither observer saw destruction. This refutes using missing TargetDestroyed as proof that old execution is still alive.

Exact Chrome141.0.7390.37 source rejects StartWorker on redundant versions. A correlated version that is both stopped and redundant cannot restart. The retained host owner remains unknown and is unnecessary for this execution contract.
Stopping/redundant is insufficient, as is stopped/activated: the latter may restart. The new branch requires stopped AND redundant in the latest post-click old-version event.

source_contract.finding: StartWorker lines545-570 explicitly rejects redundant versions with kErrorRedundant; stopped plus redundant is execution retirement, not ordinary idle stop.
WorkerStopped lines317-331 marks WORKER_TERMINATED, clears process/route and renderer; host destruction is separate.
OnWorkerVersionUpdated serializes version/registration IDs and actual running/version status; optional targetId comes from live-worker lookup.
